messages:
emily-people-ops: Quick update  we've published an overhaul of the Performance Management & PIP section in the handbook. Key changes: clearer PIP triggers, shortened timelines for pilot teams, new manager calibration steps, and a mandatory manager microlearning on documentation best practices. Please review and complete the manager checklist + quiz by next Thurs. Handbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/HR/pages/Performance+Mgmt+PIP

ryan-eng-mgr: Thanks Emily. For managers: can you confirm whether a PIP now requires a 1:1 cadence minimum (weekly/biweekly) and who signs off on escalations? We're planning coverage for my team.

emily-people-ops: Good Q. New guidance: weekly 1:1s recommended during active PIP; weekly progress notes required. Escalations: people-ops + manager of manager sign-off for any PIP extending beyond 60 days. I updated the checklist with an approval flow diagram.

priya-people-analytics: Heads-up: we added a new calibration spreadsheet for cross-team scoring and a CSV import tool for batch uploads. Managers should export their team CSV from Workday and drop into the tracker. Schema below. We'll run an initial calibration for pilot teams next Tue.

training-bot: Assigned microlearning "PIP Documentation & Calibration (Managers)" to affected managers. Due: 2026-06-05. Link: https://training.redwood.com/assignments/pip-mgr-2026

tasha-legal: Legal note: revised phrasing to clarify that PIPs are not disciplinary actions per se and to ensure were preserving performance improvement intent. For EU/UK employees added statutory consultation checkpoints; contractors excluded unless reclassified. Pushed the legal diff to Confluence.

dan-payroll: Payroll question: will there be any pay adjustments tied to PIP outcomes (e.g., merit hold, bonus ineligibility)? Need clear flags for comp exports.

emily-people-ops: For the pilot, no automatic pay adjustments. Any comp impacts must go through Comp Review and be coded manually. Priyas spreadsheet includes a "comp_flag" column we can use to signal reviews.

priya-people-analytics: Sample CSV header for the calibration import: employee_id,manager_id,role,performance_score,calibration_bucket,pip_flag,comp_flag,notes
```
employee_id,manager_id,role,performance_score,calibration_bucket,pip_flag,comp_flag,notes
55522,ryan-eng-mgr,Senior-Eng,2.1,Needs-Improvement,Yes,Review,Q2 performance drop due to project X
```

ryan-eng-mgr: Will managers get a validation report back after upload? Want to catch missing manager IDs before calibration.

priya-people-analytics: Yes  the import returns an error CSV and a summary. We'll publish an upload checklist and validation script snippet managers can run locally.

training-bot: Published short quiz (6 Qs) to validate manager understanding of documentation, signatures, and timelines. You must score 80% to complete the requirement. Link in the assignment.

emily-people-ops: Action items (short): 1) Managers: review handbook and fill calibration spreadsheet, 2) Complete microlearning + quiz, 3) People Analytics: enable import validation by Monday, 4) Legal: finalize EU addenda by EOD Fri, 5) Payroll: confirm comp flag mapping. I'll track owners in the rollout doc.

tasha-legal: One more legal flag: for Germany we need an attachment checklist in German and a doc retention schedule. I'll add the localized checklist and retention note to the EMEA section.

dan-payroll: I can confirm comp_flag mapping. Proposed payroll export mapping: employee_id,period,comp_flag(code),notes. I'll push mapping to the ops checklist.

ack-bot: Created event "Performance Calibration: Pilot Managers" on Tue 2026-06-09 09:00 PT. RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/pc-pilot-2026

emily-people-ops: Thanks all. Please post any blocker questions here. Priya  can you seed the first calibration sheet with pilot teams so managers can review before the meeting?

priya-people-analytics: Will do by EOD tomorrow. I'll also share the validation script gist for managers to preview.

ryan-eng-mgr: Thanks  I'll schedule a short prep with my team and complete the microlearning. Quick ask  can we get a one-pager on evidence expectations for low-perf ratings?

emily-people-ops: Yep  adding a one-pager and documentation examples to the handbook page now. Will notify when uploaded. :white_check_mark:
